_README: Curated affix-NAME ambiguity decisions (KTD10/U10; hardened U6.5). AFFIX NAMES ONLY. The lint SURFACES near-duplicates; a human (or the co-occurrence detector) decides same-vs-distinct here. NEVER auto-merge. 'aliases' rewrites a variant to its canonical entry (incl. the U6.5-ported semantic synonyms whose canonical is verified native). 'distinct' whitelists similar-but-different pairs so the lint stops flagging them and serves as anti-false-merge test fixtures; entries are either a bare [A,B] pair or a {pair,reason} object (the co-occurrence detector auto-classifies same-item pairs DISTINCT with evidence).

_meta.scope: affix names only; types use type_stacking_equivalence.json; slots/augments are closed sets (no alias table)
_meta.distinct_note: High-similarity-but-distinct pairs (Alchemical Air/Fire, 1d4/1d6, +66/+108, Summon Monster II/III, etc.) are auto-seeded distinct by the non-blocking lint and are NOT enumerated here; only the punctuation-collision danger pairs are pinned as explicit anti-false-merge anchors.
_meta.u65_notes: U6.5: ported 12 legacy STAT_ALIASES semantic synonyms (Str/Dex/.../Cha, PRR/MRR, Physical/Magical Resistance Rating, Fortification Bypass -> Armor-Piercing); 'All Abilities'->'All Ability Scores' was NOT ported because 'All Ability Scores' is not a native registry affix. Added 35 same-item co-occurrence-proven distinct pairs (incl. Blood Rage/Bloodrage). % / (%) unit marker is significant (flat-vs-percent is always distinct).
_meta.vocabulary_divergence_note: 2026-08-18 (#374): upstream renamed ten stats we store under the in-game enchantment names. Rather than migrate the whole product (solver tables, goldens, saved characters, docs), the divergence is absorbed HERE — their name is an alias of ours, so a refreshed import lands on our canon and the picker resolves either spelling. Re-check this list whenever the snapshot is refreshed: a name upstream adds to the flip is a silent vocabulary change until it is aliased.

Doubles as picker discoverability — a player who types upstream's name still finds it.

This alias keeps a player who ranked the engraved name — or a saved build that carries it — resolving to the stat that now scores it. The engraved name still shows on the item card, via `via`.

#649 — `Unconsciousness Range` is the canonical for this mechanic (the wiki's own phrase, 'Extending unconsciousness range' on https://ddowiki.com/page/Unconscious). This alias keeps a player who ranked the engraved name — or a saved build that carries it — resolving to the stat that now scores it. The engraved name still shows on the item card, via `via`. This one carries the weight: `Undying` was the CANONICAL until #649, so every build saved before that ranks it by name. Without this entry those priorities resolve to nothing and silently score zero — the failure mode is a build that still loads, still solves, and quietly stops optimising the stat the player asked for.

bonus TYPE vs affix NAME, not synonyms -- Ravil's Book grants False Life with bonus type Vitality natively, so targeting False Life already catches it; the literal Vitality-named affixes (Chimera's Vitality, Pirate Vitality) are unrelated Bool procs. Aliasing would be a false merge (cf. the Blood Rage/Bloodrage lesson). Ruled 2026-08-01, docs/reports/2026-08-01-bug-report-audit.md section 2.

different bonus-type channels that legitimately stack, not synonyms -- Spell Lore is Equipment/Insight/Exceptional/Artifact, Universal Spell Lore is Exceptional-only, and ten items (the Longsword of the Undying Age family) carry BOTH at different bonus types. Merging would collapse two genuinely-stacking sources. Ruled 2026-08-04, docs/wiki-evidence/spell-lore.md.
